newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups Telmex '96 ests.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups Telmex '96 ests.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said on Monday that it has increased its 1996 per ADR earnings forecast for Telmex to $4.07 from a previously forecast $3.69.
-- The company said it has decreased its 1997 earnings per ADR to $3.22 from $3.40.
-- Morgan Stanley said the changes reflect their new peso foecast for year-end 1996 of 7.91 per U.S. dollar vs 8.16 previously.
-- "Our operational assumptions remain the same, but Telmex's foreign exchange loss should now be much lower in 1996 and higher in 1997," the report prepared by Luiz F. Carvalho said.

-- "We believe that consensus earnings estimates for Telmex (currently $3.56) do not yet reflect a stronger-than- estimated Mexican currency at year-end and will have to be revised upwards soon," the report said.
-- It added that the impact of the recently announced rate increases in long-distance service should be minimal.
-- For 1997, Morgan Stanley's exchange rate forecast changes to 9.40 per U.S. dollar from 9.38.
-- Telemex earned $1.00 per ADS in the first quarter and $0.95 in the second quarter of the year.
-- Morgan Stanley is estimating earnings of $1.05 in the third quarter. Third quarter results are expected to be released the week of October 28.
-- It forecasts fourth quarter earning of $0.96 per ADS.
-- Telmex was off 1/4 to 33 in New York this morning.
